subject: reaper
claim: Section 7 documents the Reaper in a combat context only: it lists no doctrine variants, no mechanics and no numbers, so the claim stays unconfirmed.

payload.note: No numeric stats recorded for the Reaper; numbers may only be added once the host confirms the mechanics. No hull-plating value may be encoded until Armour Technology is ingested.
